                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    sum += digit\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    shouldDouble = !shouldDouble\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return sum % 10 === 0\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
